_comment: Splash-screen content, loaded once per page load by initLoadingScreenSlogan() in app.js. Kept separate from languages/<code>.json (the main UI string tables) since it's fetched before the language system finishes initializing and only ever needs these two things. To add a language: add its code as a key under "slogan" and under every entry in "quotes". Missing keys fall back to English. To add a quote: append a new object to "quotes" with an "en" value at minimum, plus an optional "author" field (omit it for unattributed/in-house lines -- app.js appends " — {author}" only when present).
